lines.en: My shriek cuts the deadlands first.
First a shriek, then the bite.
Ring after ring of flesh pushes forward.
A wet trail drags behind me.
I burrow through the heap of carrion.
My weight squeezes the wet mud aside.
I circle the pile of bones.
My scream echoes through the dead lands.
My rings tighten slowly as I listen.

lines.zh: 喉咙里滚着威胁的低语。
lines.en: A threatening whisper rolls in my throat.

lines.zh: 我把身子盘在骨堆下面。
lines.en: I coil my body beneath the bone pile.

lines.zh: 我的口器朝着你的方向张着。
lines.en: My mouth parts toward where you stand.

lines.zh: 肉环一收一放，慢慢呼吸。
lines.en: My rings clench and slacken, breathing.
I bury my head in carrion.

lines.zh: 我叫一声，死地都听见了。
lines.en: One scream and the dead land hears it.

lines.zh: 尖叫声拔高，我朝你转过来。
lines.en: My scream climbs as I turn toward you.

lines.zh: 喉咙里滚出一串刺耳的音。
lines.en: A string of harsh notes rolls from my throat.

lines.zh: 肉环一伸一缩，我挪近半寸。
lines.en: My rings stretch and pull; I close half an inch.

lines.zh: 叫声撞在骨堆上，又弹回来。
lines.en: My cry hits the bone heap and rebounds.
The shriek first, the teeth after.

lines.zh: 我的尖叫声先到，身体后到。
lines.en: My scream arrives before my body.
My ringed mouth opens and closes.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中，血肉蠕虫颤抖不已。
lines.en: Sibilant hiss as the Flesh Worm shudders.

lines.zh: 痛苦中，蠕虫发出吱吱声。
挣扎中，蠕虫发出嘶嘶声。
尖叫中，蠕肉蠕虫痛苦呻吟。
挣扎中，血肉蠕虫嘶嘶作响。
嘶嘶嘶，你的肉块看起来很好吃！
靠近些，我要品尝你的肉！
lines.en: Come closer, I want to taste your flesh!

lines.zh: 你的肉味在土里，我闻到了。
lines.en: Your meat smell is in the soil. I have it.

lines.zh: 血渗进泥土，我顺着找过去。
lines.en: Blood soaks the soil; I follow it to you.

lines.zh: 过来，让我享用你的血肉！
lines.en: Come, let me feast on your flesh!

lines.zh: 你那鲜美的肉块吸引着我！

lines.en: My stomach calls, give me flesh!

lines.zh: 你身上的肉块诱惑着我！
lines.en: The flesh块 on you tempts me!
Watch out, I’m going to smash you with my meat mallet!
Let my meat mallet crush you!
I’m going to bash enemies with my meat mallet!
Use my meat mallet on him!

lines.zh: 我的肉槌是致命的武器！
lines.en: My meat mallet is a deadly weapon!
Repel enemies with my meat mallet!

lines.zh: 让我的肉槌发出巨大声响！
lines.en: Let my meat mallet make a loud noise!
Cause chaos with my meat mallet!
Defeat your opponent with my meat mallet!

lines.zh: 另一声尖叫从死地那头传来。
lines.en: Another scream answers from across the dead land.

lines.zh: 放下肉槌，我就知道该找谁了。
lines.en: Set down the meat mallet, and I know who to look for.

lines.zh: 我的尖叫，另一条都听见了。
lines.en: My scream carried to the other one.
Find a partner to survive together!
Find a partner to mate with!

lines.zh: 我们需要一个配偶来交配！
lines.en: We need a mate to mate with!

lines.zh: 我的尖叫，是求偶，不是威胁。
lines.en: My scream is a courtship, not a threat.
Reproduce to keep the species alive!

lines.zh: 这颗牙，我用舌头卷起来了。
lines.en: I curl this tooth up with my tongue.

lines.zh: 这一声尖叫，是告诉全场我到了。
lines.en: This scream tells the whole place I have arrived.

lines.zh: 肉块拖进嘴，我一圈圈咽下。
lines.en: I drag the meat in and swallow it ring by ring.

lines.zh: 这颗牙，是从我嘴里掉的。
lines.en: That tooth fell from my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的肉槌即将派上用场！
尖叫一声，死地都知道我来了。
lines.en: One scream and the deadlands know I've come.

lines.zh: 放下的肉槌，把我叫来了。
lines.en: The meat mallet placed down called me here.

lines.zh: 享受这致命的拥抱，猎物！
肉槌即将敲碎你的骨头！

lines.en: I coil my body into a ring.
My mouth aims at your ankle.
The soil gives way beneath me.

lines.zh: 我把身子甩起来，砸你的肩。
lines.en: I whip my body up and slam your shoulder.

lines.zh: 肉槌落地的声音，把我引来。
lines.en: The sound of the flesh mallet hitting ground drew me.

lines.zh: 我张开环口，罩住你的手腕。
lines.en: I open my ringed mouth and cover your wrist.

lines.zh: 一圈牙咬下去，越收越紧。
lines.en: My ring of teeth bites down and keeps tightening.

lines.zh: 这一声尖叫，贴着你的耳朵。
lines.en: This scream lands right against your ear.
My scream arrives before my teeth.

lines.zh: 我的叫声先到，身体后到。
lines.en: My scream arrives before my body does.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，把身子缠上去。
lines.en: I bite and hold, winding my body up your arm.

lines.zh: 这声尖叫，就是你的葬礼曲。
lines.en: This shriek is your funeral song.
Lower the mallet to summon me!

lines.zh: 我的尖叫，先割你的耳朵。
lines.en: My shriek cuts your ears first.
Here I come to the gaze hill!
The flesh mallet lands; the soil stirs.

lines.zh: 死地深处传来一声尖叫。
lines.en: A scream rises from deep in the dead lands.

lines.zh: 火焰燃烧，血肉蠕虫嘶嘶尖叫。
跌落时，血肉蠕虫痛苦哀号。
溺水时，血肉蠕虫嘶嘶尖叫。
爆炸中，血肉蠕虫尖叫连连。
被击中，血肉蠕虫吱吱尖叫。
魔法攻击，血肉蠕虫哀嚎连连。
饥饿时，血肉蠕虫吱吱哀鸣。
雷击时，血肉蠕虫尖叫刺耳。
坠入虚空，血肉蠕虫嘶嘶尖叫。
